Name: Extra Museum Space
Author: RaffieJohn
Description:
Do you have a lot of Gems and artifacts from other mods that make it hard to reach perfection? This is the mod for you! It adds over 100 spaces to put your artifacts and gems anywhere you like!

Compatibility:
- SVE
- Interior mods
- VMV (Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius)
- Jasper
- Geology Mod for 1.6
- Make Gunther Real

Not Compatible With:
- NONE SO FAR




Thank you everyone in SDV discord for testing this!
